level.title: Geographic level
level.description: Choose EPA's eGRID subregions, state totals, the national total, or NERC regions.

subregions.title: eGRID subregion codes
subregions.description: Filter subregion results by four-letter EPA codes such as CAMX, NYCW or ERCT. Leave empty for all published subregions.

states.title: State codes
states.description: Filter state results by two-letter postal codes such as CA, NY or PR. Leave empty for all states and territories published in each selected year.

dataYears.title: Data years
dataYears.description: Enter a JSON array of integer data years, for example [2023, 2022]. Leave empty to discover EPA's latest data year.

pollutants.title: Pollutants
pollutants.description: Select one or more pollutants. Empty uses CO2, CH4, N2O, and CO2e. NOx rates are annual.

rateType.title: Rate type
rateType.description: Select the EPA annual total output, non-baseload output, or combustion output rate. All are electricity output rates in lb/MWh.
